name: Elizabeth
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Elizabeth, NJ 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Elizabeth, NJ for 2026: two tree lightings, Santa on the Square, Warinanco skating and Union Township's Winter Wonderland.
lede: Elizabeth lights two trees on two Tuesdays, adds Santa on three Saturdays at Union Square and shares a county skating party and a township Winter Wonderland with its neighbors.
celebrates: Elizabeth's Christmas season runs through its city hall, its downtown partnership and its county parks. The Elizabeth Avenue Partnership lights a tree at Union Square Plaza with Santa, vendors, choirs and dances, according to the city's events calendar. The city's own Miracle on Winfield Scott fills City Hall with a tree lighting, Mr. and Mrs. Claus, caroling and live music, and Visit Elizabeth calls it free and family friendly. Holiday on the Square brings pony rides, a petting zoo and hot chocolate to Union Square on several Saturdays, and neighbors Union and Linden add celebrations of their own.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of Elizabeth's tree lightings on a host page, so this page leans on the host pages for the current season. What the sources do show is a format that repeats: Visit Elizabeth describes Miracle on Winfield Scott as an annual festival in front of City Hall that typically takes place in early December, and the avenue partnership's lighting is listed on the city calendar as its annual tree lighting. Families can expect the same mix of Santa, music and vendors from year to year.
facts: Elizabeth keeps its holiday listings on the City of Elizabeth events calendar, where the avenue partnership's lighting and Santa on the Square both appear. Visit Elizabeth, the city's tourism site, lists Miracle on Winfield Scott as a festival held in front of City Hall at 50 Winfield Scott Plaza and says it typically takes place in early December. Union County runs Celebrate the Season at Warinanco Sports Center, with skate rental, hot chocolate and cookies included in the ticket.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Elizabeth itself. Our New Jersey guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-new-jersey lists the Christmas train rides across the state, including the Santa Claus Express at the Pine Creek Railroad in Monmouth County and the Santa Express at Black River and Western Railroad in Flemington. Families who want a train day usually plan a drive.
traditions: The avenue partnership lights its annual tree at Union Square Plaza with Santa, vendors and choirs.
The city's tree lighting at City Hall has Santa, caroling and live music, and it is free.
Santa, pony rides and a petting zoo return to Union Square Plaza on several Saturdays.
Union County hosts skating, hot chocolate and cookies at Warinanco Sports Center.
kidfact: Elizabeth lights two Christmas trees in December, one on Elizabeth Avenue and one at City Hall, just a week apart.
faq: What are the best Christmas events for kids in Elizabeth, NJ?

Families can look to the city's free Miracle on Winfield Scott tree lighting, the avenue partnership's Santa on the Square Saturdays and Union County's skating party at Warinanco. Nearby Union and Linden host their own tree lighting and Winter Wonderland events.
Is there a free tree lighting in Elizabeth?

Yes. Visit Elizabeth describes Miracle on Winfield Scott at City Hall as free and family friendly, with Santa, caroling and live music. It typically takes place in early December on the plaza at 50 Winfield Scott Plaza.
Where can kids meet Santa in Elizabeth?
Santa appears at the avenue partnership's tree lighting at Union Square, at Miracle on Winfield Scott, at Santa on the Square on several Saturdays and at The Mills at Jersey Gardens.
Does Elizabeth have its own Christmas Eve services page?
Not yet. We checked and there is no Elizabeth page for Christmas Eve services, so use the city's events calendar for community listings.
